intro.text: The presence or absence of Initiation.DebtorAccount in domestic_payment_pii determines whether the user selects their account at the LFI or if it is pre-selected by the TPP.
Passing a DebtorAccount reduces friction for users who have already selected their account within the TPP's own interface, but removes the user's ability to choose a different account at the LFI.
Control parameters define the spending rules for the consent and are displayed in the Payment rules card on both the TPP Consent Page and the LFI Authorisation Page.
There are two groups of control parameters: overall limits that apply across the full lifetime of the consent, and per-period limits that reset each period.

rows: The maximum number of individual payments that can be made across the entire consent. Only shown when provided.
The maximum total amount that can be paid across the entire consent. Only shown when provided.
The maximum amount allowed for a single payment. Always shown.
The maximum number of payments within a single period (e.g. per Week). The period type from PeriodType is substituted into the label. Only shown when provided.
The maximum total value of payments within a single period. The period type from PeriodType is substituted into the label. Only shown when provided.
